This app is built on and calls the following open-source projects; sincere thanks and respect to their authors:

1. ApkDataMultiplexing (L-JINBIN)
 Reuses the original package data segment via central-directory offsets and removes duplicate data, significantly shrinking resigned packages (up to ~50%), with the V2V3SchemeSigner signing scheme
 - Home: https://github.com/L-JINBIN/ApkDataMultiplexing
 - License: not specified, for learning only

2. dexlib2 / smali / baksmali (JesusFreke)
 DEX read/write and smali disassembly/assembly toolchain, the core ad-removal engine
 - Home: https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali
 - License: BSD 3-Clause

3. apksig (Android Open Source Project)
 APK v1 / v2 / v3 signing so results install successfully
 - Home: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/tools/apksig
 - License: Apache License 2.0

4. BouncyCastle : bcprov / bcpkix
 Java crypto and certificate generation library for signing certificates
 - Home: https://www.bouncycastle.org/
 - License: MIT License

5. Guava (Google)
 Java collections and utilities providing the immutable collections dexlib2 needs
 - Home: https://github.com/google/guava
 - License: Apache License 2.0

6. AndroidX (Android Open Source Project)
 core-ktx / appcompat / constraintlayout / recyclerview / lifecycle / coordinatorlayout
 Android's official Jetpack support libraries
 - Home: https://developer.android.com/jetpack
 - License: Apache License 2.0

7. Material Components (Google)
 Material Design component library providing cards, buttons, dialogs and other UI components
 - Home: https://github.com/material-components/material-components-android
 - License: Apache License 2.0

8. Kotlin Standard Library (JetBrains)
 The Kotlin programming language and standard library
 - Home: https://kotlinlang.org/
 - License: Apache License 2.0

9. DTL-X (Gameye98)
 Reference for ad class / method / URL pattern rules
 - Home: https://github.com/Gameye98/DTL-X
 - For pattern reference and learning only; its binaries were not modified

10. Android Asset Packaging Tool (AAPT2)
 Android resource compilation and packaging tool for AXML / resource processing
 - Home: https://developer.android.com/tools/aapt2
 - License: Apache License 2.0

11. MT Manager ApkSignatureKillerEx sample (Bin.MT)
 Source of the signature-verification-removal hook class (bin.mt.signature.KillerApplication) and native library ideas
 - Home: https://mt2.cn/

This app follows the principle of minimal collection and highly values and protects your privacy:

1. Fully offline: all APK unpacking, ad removal, repacking and signing happen locally on your device. The app never uploads any APK file or internal data to a server.

2. Transparent networking: the app only contacts the network to request version info when you tap “Check Update”; it never networks, collects or uploads any personal info in the background at other times.

3. Minimal permissions: the app does not read, store or access sensitive data such as your contacts, gallery, location, SMS or call logs.

4. Local data storage: configuration and patterns are stored only on your device and deleted when the app is uninstalled, with no cloud records retained.

5. Third-party links: the About and update pages may contain external links; clicking them lets a third-party platform process your access, so please review their privacy policies.

6. If you have any privacy questions, suggestions or concerns, feel free to contact us through the author's contact info and we will do our best to help.

During development this app referred to the following public technical documents, open-source tutorials and community reverse-engineering materials. We thank the authors and state the sources here:

1. Direct DEX patching (based on dexlib2)
 Referenced Facebook's former android-dexdump ideas and official dexlib2 examples
 - dexlib2 Home: https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali
 - Used its API docs and examples to locate and rewrite ad classes/methods/strings ourselves

2. AXML binary format parsing (Android Asset Packaging)
 Referenced AOSP's XmlPullParser and AXML binary format documentation
 - Source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/ (core/res)
 - Written based on AXML chunk headers, the resource StringPool/ResourceMap structure and public reverse-engineering materials

3. Dart AOT snapshot parsing (Flutter libapp.so)
 Referenced the Dart VM source snapshot.h and community Flutter reverse-engineering materials
 - snapshot.h: https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/blob/main/runtime/vm/snapshot.h
 - Used to locate the Dart snapshot header inside libapp.so and extract/neutralize ad strings

4. Ad pattern rule organization
 Ad SDK package names / domains / class keywords referenced and extended from the open-source project DTL-X
 - Home: https://github.com/Gameye98/DTL-X
 - Referenced its adloader / domain blacklist / method keyword ideas and organized them with mainstream ad SDKs

5. APK v1 / v2 signing and alignment
 Referenced apksig's official implementation and Android's ZIP alignment documentation
 - apksig: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/tools/apksig
 - ZIP alignment: https://developer.android.com/studio/command-line/zipalign

6. Data multiplexing (resigned package size optimization)
 Referenced L-JINBIN's ApkDataMultiplexing project and the LSPatch resigned-package structure
 - Home: https://github.com/L-JINBIN/ApkDataMultiplexing
 - Idea source: the LSP team (resigned package + IO redirection against whole-package checks)
 - Principle: reuse the original package data segment via central-directory offsets and remove duplicate data for size optimization
 - Ported its DataMultiplexing / ZipMaker / ZipFile / V2V3SchemeSigner implementations

7. UI theme and layout
 Written based on Material Design specs and Material Components library examples
 - Spec: https://m3.material.io/
 - Components: https://github.com/material-components/material-components-android

8. Signature verification removal (resigning)
 Referenced MT Manager ApkSignatureKillerEx's hook injection ideas:
 - Inject a KillerApplication hook class and change the Application reference in the manifest
 - The hook reads and caches the signature via PackageManager in <clinit>, covering getPackageInfo / native checks
 - Original-Package mode: embeds the original APK and resigned native library, reading the original signature for wider coverage
 - Source: https://mt2.cn/ (for learning only)

9. DEX class renaming (custom hook class name)
 Referenced dexlib2's official RewriterModule / TypeRewriter examples to rewrite both the class definition and all references
 - Source: https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali
 - Rewrites by type-descriptor prefix matching, compatible with dot / slash / L...; input forms

Flutter apps (AOT) embed a Dart snapshot in libapp.so, which stores strings such as ad SDK package names, ad URLs/domains, and ad class names as raw ASCII bytes. This maintains string patterns to be erased from the snapshot: when matched, they are overwritten with equal-length NUL bytes during libapp.so unpack/remove-ad/repack, making the ad string content ineffective.
